title: Chapter 892
paragraphs: Chapter 892
Episode 223. Uncomfortable Meetings (3)
"I pledge my loyalty."
February 1, 1804.
Jito looked down at a human who had come to visit the underworld. He knelt on one knee before Jito, asking to be accepted as a member of the underworld.
[Ah, it's annoying.]
Jito openly showed his disgust looking at him.
The passage between the underworld and Inse is not yet fully open. The Bongmabyeok (Sealing Wall) was damaged, but it had not entirely lost its function.
Therefore, for a human to descend to Inse at this time, the help of a special being was needed. Even coming directly to Jito's dwelling without the Bongmabyeok was nearly impossible.
As far as Jito knew, there was only one person capable of such a feat.
[Heluram sent you, didn't she? Damn it, I knew she didn't tell me the full price of our last deal…… The price was to accept you?]
The man did not respond but slowly raised his head.
Although he knelt and pledged loyalty, there was no trace of servility about him.
Surprisingly, he faced Jito with a dignified demeanor. Jito wanted to discipline him on the spot, but he couldn't. He was certain that this was the price Heluram wanted.
[I suppose the witch didn't approach you first, your god pleaded with the witch. He asked her to arrange for me to accept you. My, how the mighty have fallen. Shino used to be so arrogant.]
The man's name was Kelliac Ziphel.

There was no longer any trace of a soul within him. His eyes radiated with the aura of a peak magician, and his new staff, reminiscent of the Ziphel family's emblem 'Huroti', seemed ready to unleash a torrent of magic power at any moment.
[Hm, I'm not sure what Heluram is thinking. So you tell me, then I'll accept you. She's really creepy at times like this. Ugh, disgusting. In some ways, she's worse than love and peace.]
"I haven't heard the stories of the gods directly."
[Ah, this guy... So you're just acting brave because the higher-ups have already decided? You know that if I drag you to the torture room for play, Heluram will flip. Right?]
"If you don't accept me, I'll leave immediately. My goal is to reclaim my family, so even if you let me go, there won't be any loss for you, Jito."
[No, no. What if you succeed in reclaiming your family? Then you might regret your choice now, and attack us, perhaps with a fully completed Mashinseok (Devil's Stone).]
"Think as you wish."

[Even though you were trodden on by your little ones and facing death not long ago, it seems that your pride of being a loser on the ground remains. Can't take a single word, huh? I really detest that kind of attitude.]
"Will you accept me?"
Jito put his hand on his forehead.
As he had told Kelliac, it was because he couldn't read Heluram's thoughts.
'We were talking and playing just a few days ago, even about minor things…... Indeed, Heluram is Heluram.'
Since the start of the Inse conquest, there had not been a day as uncomfortable as today for Jito.

Even when Biseptus caused a fuss, when Orgal nearly died, when he heard news of a red power user among humans, when he partially lost his power because of Ayura, or when his subordinates were broken time and again, Jito thought it was no big deal.
But not this time. This time, he could not predict at all the variables this human, Kelliac Ziphel, would bring.
The problem was that he could not refuse. If he did, Heluram would undoubtedly bring him a 'bigger problem.'
[Ah, I'll accept you. But don't do anything until I give instructions. You're just air, a rock on the side of the road, the root of a bald head. Meaning, you're invisible, immovable, and useless.]
"I understand."
Shortly thereafter, Jito waved his hand once in the air, and a dimensional gate opened. It was a dimensional gate leading to Ragal's poison castle.
"Oh, Lord Jito!?"
[Hey, Ragal. Put this guy in the dungeon number 3 of your castle.]
"Uh... Dungeon number 3?"
[Why, did you hide something there?]
"Haha, hiding something? Where would I have a secret from you, Lord Jito? Oh, what? It's a human! And this face, isn't this Kelliac Ziphel who was purged? How did he get to the underworld?"
[I've felt this way for a long time, but our Ragal is very curious. Huh, I'm already annoyed because of this, you know?]
"Being curious, this poison... is the charm of your darling Ragal. Hmm, how should I treat him?"
[Think of it as raising a plant. Give it food and water so it doesn't die, and if it seems too withered, give it more.]
"So, you mean don't touch him, understood."
As Jito signaled, Kelliac passed through the dimensional gate. Jito closed the dimensional gate with a consistently disgruntled voice.
"Dungeon number 3…… I wonder if Lord Jito has recognized my surprise gift? That would be troublesome. What do you think?"
"I'm not sure."
"Ah, I should introduce myself first. I am Ragal Fun, the king of the extremely poisonous region of the Demon World."
"I'm Kelliac Ziphel."
"Speaking of which, this guy is quite reticent... Well, that's how it is with once successful guys."
"Elevate if you wish."
"I didn't mean it that way."
Ragal was in high spirits as soon as Jito entrusted Kelliac to him.
He thought it was because Jito trusted him that much.

"Let me guess, you made a deal with the witch Heluram. So you could go to Jito's residence without anyone knowing, and Jito accepted you, a human. And Jito! He trusts this Ragal so he left you to me."

Kelliac did not respond and calmly looked around the poison castle. It wasn't much different from the castle of Inse. Just the artificial sunlight coming in through the windows was paler than the real sun, and the souls of humans who had fallen to hell were doing odd jobs.
"I'm very curious about you. Jito said not to touch you. But that just means don't torture you. So depending on what you do, we can become as friendly as we want."
"Lord Jito wants me to do nothing."

"Of course, he can't know what Heluram is thinking! But listen, friend Kelliac. It's right for you to do nothing, but I can gain merit through the information or abilities you have. It could be the reason why Lord Jito sent you to me."
Humming a tune, Ragal led Kelliac to Dungeon No. 3. The dungeons of the poison castle were all underground. With each step down the stairs, horrifying screams of souls being tortured echoed.
Dungeon No. 3 was one of the dungeons on the lowest floor, and it had a completely different atmosphere from the entrance.
It was more like a monastery than a dungeon, filled with a clean and quiet feeling. Even more terrifying screams were heard from Dungeons No. 1 and 2 next door.

"Our Dungeon No. 3, let's see... traditionally... it's a place for reformation. Especially close to religious reformation. So the prison guards and torturers were called saints during their lifetime. Of course, the fact that the saints came to hell means that they were filthy enough to come here."
As Ragal approached, the guards dressed in priest clothes bowed their heads.
"Is the work going well?"
"Yes, one is now fully reformed, Lord Ragal. The other three are being adjusted in rooms 1 and 2."
"Still adjusting three? Ho, they are enduring better than expected. Even if they endure, they will eventually come to room 3. How good would it be to just come here and relax?"
"They will all gather in room 3 within the next three days. By the way, is this a newcomer?"
“The newcomer is indeed a newcomer, but not a subject of reformation. He's a new friend of mine that you guys should serve to the best of your abilities."
"I didn't know, sir. We'll greet him!"
The jailers bowed their heads towards Kelriak.
Then, the jailers opened the door to Cell 3. Inside, it looked like a huge chapel, except the stained-glass images weren't of Aiyura or Insae's known gods, but Zito.
In the middle was a woman, kneeling and studying a thick book like a bible. And she was someone Kelriak Ziphil knew very well.
"...Ann Runekandel?"
Ann Runekandel.

The ninth of the Runekandels, and alongside her sister Mu, one of the first to accept chaos. She died at the hands of the Black Knight Mon, who came to aid during a battle with the Tona brothers at the Shrine of Abomination. With the Prophet extinguished, she could not even be resurrected.
Naturally, she did not reincarnate but fell into Hell. Ann kept her eyes closed and continued to chant something like a prayer.
“Then in Cells 1 and 2.”

"Mu Runekandel, and Ran Runekandel and Vugo Runekandel are there. Currently, Paelito has halted the production of soul wine, which our demons enjoy, to find these people. They intend to use them to strike at Luna Runekandel."
-Sakiel.
-Yes, Lord Paelito.

-We will temporarily halt the production of soul wine. And scour Hell to confirm the existence of Luna Runekandel's siblings. They would have fallen into Hell. They will definitely be there, provided they haven't already turned into soul wine.
The conversation Paelito and Sakiel had when Luna treated the Grand Rift in the Hufesiter Shiatello with red sword energy.
Ragal did not directly hear this conversation but saw right through Paelito's plan. He had his lieutenant 'Gero' secure them before Paelito could.

"Kelriak, my friend, I'm going to use these people to give Zito a surprise gift. The gift of the End of Revelation. However, it's not only the Runekandel ones that come to our Hell. Even your former subordinates are consistently coming in."
"......You want me to select the useful ones among them?"

"Oh, you understand well! From today, I'll constantly send the souls of the Ziphil to this Cell 3 where you will reside. You just need to select the necessary ones, and through them, I will make a contribution for Zito. How about it, simple, isn't it?"
"Let it be so."
"Hahaha, good. Then rest a bit, I'll bring something tasty in the evening. Maybe have a sip of soul wine."
Ragal left. The jailers carefully observed Kelriak's mood and went back to their tasks.
Kelriak quietly smiled.
Thinking about Ganesto's blood.
